messages:
maria: quick FYI — hitting parity gaps between SDK (js v0.8.1) and REST for the generate endpoint when using streaming + retries.
kevin: ugh, can you paste the call you used?
maria: calling REST with curl works:
```
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-rt-1","input":"hello","stream":true,"temperature":0.2}'
```
maria: same payload using SDK: `client.generate({model: 'redwood-rt-1', input: 'hello', stream: true, temp: 0.2})` — SDK ignores `stream: true` and also expects `temp` not `temperature`.
ashley: whoa, parameter renaming? that's a breaking DX issue. docs definitely show `temperature` for REST.
kevin: SDK was trying to be concise and used `temp` internally, but shouldn't diverge. Will open a PR.
maria: also observed retry behavior: when ephemeral auth fails (401 refresh), REST returns 401 then client retries after refresh; SDK isn't retrying streaming calls — it just fails the stream and doesn't attempt refresh+retry.
jon: streaming + auth refresh is tricky because you need to recreate the stream and replay initial frames. Do we have an idempotency token on generate?
kevin: generate supports `request_id` but SDK isn't wiring it into streaming reconnection logic.
maria: repro steps are short: set token to expire mid-stream, trigger generation of ~500 tokens. REST reconnect flow: server returns a `401` chunk, client refreshes token and resumes. SDK flow: immediate stream close and no retry.
ashley: can you paste SDK trace?
maria: stack: `Error: stream closed (401)`; header from server: `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"`
kevin: noted. I'll add two items to the PR: 1) alias `temperature` -> `temp` in SDK input parsing 2) implement streaming auth-refresh + auto-reconnect using `request_id` replay.
ashley: and update docs + changelog. This needs a patch release (0.8.2) — breaking for anyone who used temperature naming or expected streaming retries.
maria: one more small mismatch: REST allows `max_new_tokens` while SDK uses `maxTokens`. Minor but causes param drift in sample apps.
jon: can we add compatibility layer mapping: temperature -> temp, max_new_tokens -> maxTokens, top_p -> nucleus for the short term?
kevin: yes, compatibility shim in parser + explicit warning logs on console so customers see deprecation.
ashley: any impact on telemetry/console dashboards? would like to show how often people hit these errors.
kevin: devex-bot: created issue #487 for SDK parity: streaming auth retry + param aliases.
devex-bot: Issue #487 created by kevin: "SDK: parity fixes — streaming auth-reconnect, parameter aliasing (temperature, max_new_tokens)"
maria: thanks. I'll add a tiny failing test in sample-apps that force-expires tokens mid-stream so CI catches regressions.
ashley: quick follow-up — sample app quickstart in repo `examples/streaming-chat` also used `temperature` in README. We'll need to update examples before the release.
kevin: plan: patch branch -> add aliasing shim + streaming retry logic (with request_id replay) -> unit tests + integration test in examples -> release 0.8.2.
maria: tagging @ashley for docs updates and @jon for integration test review.
ashley: noted. Will prep docs PR after kevin's changes land. :thumbsup:
kevin: ETA tomorrow for PR, aiming for patch release by EOD Thu.
maria: awesome — thanks all. if anyone sees other param drift please drop them here and i'll add to the issue. :sparkles:
